subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Inferir e justificar, em textos multissemióticos – tirinhas, charges, memes, gifs etc. –, o efeito de humor, ironia e/ou crítica pelo uso ambíguo de palavras, expressões ou imagens ambíguas, de clichês, de recursos iconográficos, de pontuação etc.

components.description_pt: Identificar recursos linguísticos e visuais como trocadilhos, clichês, pontuação e recursos iconográficos para produzir humor ou ironia
components.description_en: Identify linguistic and visual devices — such as wordplay, clichés, punctuation, and iconographic resources — used to produce humor or irony in multisemiotic texts
components.cc_component_description: Interpret the meaning of figurative language including metaphor, allusion, and irony in context

components.description_pt: Inferir efeitos de humor, ironia ou crítica social através do uso ambíguo de palavras ou imagens em histórias em quadrinhos, memes ou charges
components.description_en: Infer the effect of humor, irony, or social critique achieved through ambiguous use of words or images in comic strips, memes, or editorial cartoons
components.cc_component_description: Identify the use of irony, sarcasm, or understatement in a literary text

components.description_pt: Justificar como escolhas semióticas específicas em texto multissemiótico constroem efeito de significado crítico ou irônico
components.description_en: Justify how specific semiotic choices in a multisemiotic text construct a critical or ironic meaning effect
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how specific rhetorical choices strengthen or shape an author's argument

cc_matches.description: Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings.
Analyze a case in which grasping point of view requires distinguishing what is directly stated in a text from what is really meant (e.g., satire, sarcasm, irony, or understatement).
Determine an author's point of view or purpose in a text and analyze how an author uses rhetoric to advance that point of view or purpose.
